title: Proposition
body_md: The optimum is $5/32$ for the Csirmaz 2013 catalogue, for the union of DFZ with Csirmaz 2016, and for the union of all three catalogues. It is also $5/32$ for the smaller system consisting of the 28 Shannon rows and the four $G$-images of each of $\mathcal D$ and $\mathcal R$.

title: Proposition
body_md: Add to the polyhedron $P(\mathcal C)$ of the union of the three catalogues the blocks of all four $G$-images of all $213$ programs, that is, $852$ blocks. The optimum of $-\operatorname{Ing}$ over the resulting polyhedron is $5/32$.
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md: Theorem~\ref{thm:main} gives the upper bound. The ancillary files contain, for every program and every $G$-image, an exact rational vector on the variables of its block whose fifteen original coordinates are those of~\eqref{eq:primal} and which satisfies every row of the block. Since the blocks share only the original coordinates, these vectors combine into one feasible point with objective value $5/32$.
